scenarios.name: SMITH/JOHN MR
speech: I am fit and able to assist in an emergency if required.
Please let me know if you need volunteers.

scenarios.name: OPS/DISPATCH
speech: The aircraft assigned to this flight has changed.
Please update the departure information screens.

scenarios.name: CREW/SENIOR FA
speech: Cabin crew, please take your assigned positions.
You will be working in the aft cabin today.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/MIKE
speech: A technical issue was identified during inspection.
Please record it in the Aircraft Maintenance Log.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/SARAH
speech: The aircraft cannot continue operations.
It has been declared Aircraft on Ground.

scenarios.name: CAPT/JONES
speech: Ground power is unavailable at this stand.
Please start the Auxiliary Power Unit.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/ANNA
speech: Air Traffic Control has issued a revised departure slot.
Expect a delay of 20 minutes.

scenarios.name: CREW/LISA
speech: Please report to briefing room B.
You are rostered as Cabin Attendant on today's flight.

scenarios.name: OPS/CREW
speech: All cabin crew members should report for briefing at 08:30.
Uniform standards will be checked.

scenarios.name: TRAINER/EMMA
speech: Before operating the flight, please review the Cabin Instruction Manual.
There have been several recent updates.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/TOM
speech: A damaged seat was reported in row 12.
Please note it in the Cabin Maintenance Log.

scenarios.name: CAPT/BROWN
speech: The Captain will provide an operational briefing before departure.
Please remain seated until it is complete.

scenarios.name: WILSON/FAMILY
speech: We are travelling with a young child.
May we use our approved child restraint device on board?

scenarios.name: NURSE/AMY
speech: A passenger has collapsed in the departure lounge.
Is there anyone trained in CPR nearby?

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/PAUL
speech: The Emergency Locator Transmitter requires inspection.
Maintenance has been notified.

scenarios.name: CREW/ANNE
speech: A passenger suffered a minor cut during boarding.
Please bring the First Aid Kit.

scenarios.name: CREW/DAVID
speech: Smoke was reported in the galley oven.
Use the fire proof gloves before handling the equipment.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/JANE
speech: Flight KL747 is now ready for boarding.
Please proceed to Gate D12.

scenarios.name: CREW/MIKE
speech: A fire extinguisher was discharged during training.
Please replace the Halon bottle immediately.

scenarios.name: STUDENT/EMMA
speech: Which organization publishes airline and airport codes?
I think it might be IATA.

scenarios.name: STUDENT/TOM
speech: Which organization is responsible for international aviation standards?
I believe it is ICAO.

scenarios.name: CREW/LISA
speech: Seat 14A cannot be reclined.
Please mark it as inoperative.

scenarios.name: CREW/SARAH
speech: The forward lavatory is temporarily unavailable.
Please direct passengers to the rear facilities.

scenarios.name: INSPECTOR/JOHN
speech: All life saving appliances were checked before departure.
No defects were found.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/ROB
speech: The weather radar is inoperative.
Please consult the Minimum Equipment List before departure.

scenarios.name: DOCTOR/LISA
speech: A passenger requires medication during the flight.
Please retrieve the Medical Kit.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: Operations Control Center has approved the revised flight plan.
Proceed as briefed.

scenarios.name: CREW/EMMA
speech: An oxygen bottle was used during the previous sector.
Please ensure a replacement is available.

scenarios.name: CREW/ANNA
speech: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome on board.
This is a public announcement from your cabin crew.

scenarios.name: CREW/MARK
speech: Smoke procedures have been initiated.
Don the Protective Breathing Equipment immediately.

scenarios.name: OPS/ANNE
speech: The Passenger Information List has been printed.
Please verify the number of passengers on board.

scenarios.name: RAMP/JOE
speech: The doors are closed and the tug is connected.
Request pushback clearance from ATC.

scenarios.name: CAPT/LEE
speech: The captain aborted the take-off due to a warning indication.
The event has been classified as a rejected take-off.

scenarios.name: TRAINER/KIM
speech: Please follow the Standard Operating Procedures at all times.
They are designed to ensure safety and consistency.

scenarios.name: ATC/TOWER
speech: Flight KL764, taxi to runway 18R via taxiway Bravo.
Contact tower when ready.

scenarios.name: CAPT/SMITH
speech: Cabin crew, please take your seats immediately.
Moderate turbulence is expected ahead.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/SUE
speech: Severe weather has been reported near our destination.
Expect possible delays upon arrival.

scenarios.name: OPS/TEAM
speech: The replacement crew is required at Gate F4 as soon as possible.
Please proceed immediately.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: The Actual Time of Arrival has been recorded as 14:22 local time.
Please update the system accordingly.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: The aircraft departed the stand at 09:17.
Please enter the Actual Time of Departure.

scenarios.name: PLANNER/MIKE
speech: Based on today's routing, the Estimated Block Time is 2 hours and 15 minutes.
Fuel calculations have been completed.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/EMMA
speech: Our Estimated Time of Arrival is currently 16:45.
Passengers should be informed of the revised schedule.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/PAUL
speech: The Estimated Time of Departure has changed due to congestion.
The new departure time is 11:30.

scenarios.name: OPS/JANE
speech: The Scheduled Time of Arrival is 18:05.
Ground handling staff have been notified.

scenarios.name: OPS/MARK
speech: The Scheduled Time of Departure remains unchanged at 07:00.
Boarding will commence in 20 minutes.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/SARAH
speech: Unfortunately, the inbound aircraft has been delayed.
This is a late incoming aircraft situation.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/TOM
speech: Your flight has been delayed due to a late incoming aircraft.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: Due to adverse weather conditions, today's service has been cancelled.
Please contact customer services for rebooking options.

scenarios.name: GATE/ANNA
speech: A passenger checked in at the last minute.
Please issue a Last Minute Change notification.

scenarios.name: CAPT/JOHN
speech: Captain, the dangerous goods manifest has been updated.
Please review the NOTOC before departure.
